items.name: ASFA Speedcubing 2018

venue.name: [MCEC](http://mcec.com.au/your-visit/getting-there/)
venue.details: Speedcubing exhibit at Arnold Sports Festival Australia 2018

items.information: It will be noisy. Please bring earmuffs/plugs if you are easily distracted. Max 80 competitors. The competitor registration fee includes access to the expo. Spectators will need to purchase tickets from https://arnoldsportsfestival.com.au to enter the expo.

items.name: Bandung Zaman Now 2018

venue.name: [Click Square Mall Bandung](https://www.clicksquare.id/)
venue.details: The competition will be held on the 5th floor.

items.information: This is the 8th competition in Bandung with the theme of "Bandung Zaman Now". Held to celebrate the wave of new cubers and the rise of Rubik's Cube community in Bandung. If you are new in WCA competition or having questions about regulation, please check [WCA Regulation (English)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) or [Regulasi WCA (Bahasa Indonesia, currently outdated)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/indonesian/) The payment can be done by early bird or on the spot systems (please refer to 'Registration Fee & Payments' tab). During the registration, please add your phone number in the comment section. For more information, please contact the organizers.

items.name: BarbeCubing 2018

venue.name: KC First Church of the Nazarene
venue.address: 11811 State Line Road Kansas City, MO 64114

items.information: **The registration will be reopening on Tuesday February 13th at 5:00pm CDT!** · Registration is $20 for 2x2 and 3x3 or $25 for all events. · The competitor limit is 85. · Spectators get in free, but try not to have more than 2. · First time competitors are encouraged to attend.

items.information: **3x3 Multi-Blind is the main event of this competition.** To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue.

items.name: Rockville Qualifier 2018
items.information: The competitor limit is 40. This is a qualifier competition, meaning that its purpose is to hold events that are not commonly held to allow competitors to qualify for CubingUSA Nationals this year. We will not be holding 3x3 under any circumstances.
